decisions.reason: The height-adjustable executive desk system remains well aligned with the firm's premium office competence and the continuing need for flexible high-quality workplaces, even if several years after launch a line refresh may become more likely than a withdrawal.
A chair family is a core element of the firm's broad interior portfolio and can be configured across residential, lounge and office settings, making continued retention the most natural choice.
Floor cushions derived from carpets are the most niche offer among the retained products and are easiest to discontinue in order to free resources for stronger furniture lines and new development.

The high standing table still fits collaborative and flexible office environments and complements the firm's conference and workplace solutions, though it faces some risk if demand concentrates on fewer best-selling formats.

The rug collection is somewhat outside the historic core but supports the firm's strategic move toward holistic, materially coherent interior concepts and therefore is still worth keeping unless portfolio simplification becomes necessary.
